heading, A mission to make prescribed care as effective as possible, level 1
We are a design-led health technology company, working to help patients self-manage their conditions and improve the relationship they have with healthcare systems.

Our duty of care, above everything else, is to the people who are living with chronic conditions and using our products to manage their health. Our work is designed to empower them and help them achieve better outcomes. We design for the patient first, clinicians a close second.

We are not interested in short-termism. No shortcuts, no quick wins. Using our products means inviting a new technology into your life. That relationship, and the validity of the insights for patients and clinicians, is built on enduring trust. We don’t take this role for granted.

We want our impact to be demonstrable. That said, digital health is new in the lifetime of medicine, and things move quickly. We are willing to challenge accepted thinking and research and put significant effort into proving or disproving the value of our work.
heading, High standards, high humility, level 3

Our goal is to set the absolute highest standards in experience design for digital health. This translates into every interaction of our company, large or small. To achieve that, there is a lot we need to learn, and we don’t assume to already know the right answers.
